drivingInfo: Mauritius drives on the left-hand side of the road, similar to the UK, Australia and India. Roads are generally well-maintained and signposted.
The island is compact — most destinations are reachable within 1–2 hours from anywhere. A rental car is the perfect way to explore at your own pace.
You will need a valid driving licence from your home country. Most international licences are accepted.
The minimum driving age in Mauritius is 18 years. Renters must be 21 or over.

paragliding.name: Tandem Paragliding in Mauritius
paragliding.pageTitle: Tandem Paragliding Mauritius | MauTravel Tour Operator
paragliding.pageDescription: Soar above Mauritius on a tandem paragliding adventure with MauTravel. Four spectacular flying locations — Le Morne, Chamarel, Montagne Longue & Quatre Sœurs. From €170 per person. Certified professional pilots.
paragliding.heroSubtitle: Experience Mauritius from an entirely new perspective as you soar above mountains, lagoons, and breathtaking landscapes with a certified tandem paragliding pilot.
about: MauTravel's tandem paragliding experience offers one of the most extraordinary perspectives of Mauritius — drifting freely above volcanic peaks, forested valleys, and the endless turquoise expanse of the Indian Ocean. With four exceptional flying sites across the island, each flight reveals a different and equally breathtaking side of Mauritius that simply cannot be appreciated from the ground.

From the dramatic central highlands of Montagne Longue and the east-coast splendour of Quatre Sœurs, to the forested ridges of Chamarel and the iconic lagoon of Le Morne — every location offers its own unique landscape and atmosphere. Your pilot selects the ideal take-off site on the day based on prevailing wind and weather conditions, ensuring the finest views and the safest possible flight for every guest.

Tandem paragliding is entirely suitable for beginners — no previous experience is required. You are secured alongside a fully certified, experienced professional pilot throughout the entire flight, from take-off to landing. All flights begin with a thorough safety briefing and equipment check. Advance booking is strongly recommended to confirm your preferred date and receive personalised assistance from our team.

locations.name: Montagne Longue
locations.subtitle: Central Highlands Flying
locations.description: Set within the central highlands of Mauritius, Montagne Longue offers an authentic inland mountain paragliding experience unlike any other on the island. A gentle 20-minute ascent to the take-off point rewards you with sweeping panoramas across volcanic ridges and lush green valleys stretching in every direction.
landmarks: Potential extension toward Pieter Both (weather permitting)

locations.name: Quatre Sœurs
locations.subtitle: East Coast Adventure
locations.description: Perched on the east coast of Mauritius, Quatre Sœurs delivers a spectacular combination of mountain grandeur and ocean panoramas. A 20–30-minute ascent to the launch site reveals breathtaking views across verdant valleys, rugged ridges, and the shimmering Indian Ocean coastline stretching to the horizon.
landmarks: Views toward Les Chats et la Souris and Montagne Bambous
Sweeping valleys and mountain ridge scenery

locations.name: Chamarel
locations.subtitle: Rugged Valley Scenery
locations.description: Chamarel's rugged and richly forested landscape provides a stunning natural amphitheatre for paragliding. Just a 10-minute walk from the launch area, pilots and passengers take flight from one of Mauritius's most scenic regions — with forested mountain ridges gradually opening toward the sparkling west coast and the vast Indian Ocean beyond.
landmarks: Gradual reveal of the west coast and Indian Ocean

locations.name: Le Morne
locations.subtitle: Mauritius's Most Iconic Flight
locations.description: Le Morne is widely regarded as the most celebrated paragliding destination on the island. The 30-minute ascent to the take-off site culminates in one of Mauritius's most spectacular launches — with the legendary turquoise Le Morne lagoon spread out below, and the world-famous underwater waterfall illusion often visible from above on clear days.
landmarks: Breathtaking Le Morne lagoon and peninsula views
The iconic underwater waterfall illusion (visible from above)
Turquoise lagoon meeting the open Indian Ocean

faqs.question: Do I need previous paragliding experience?
faqs.answer: No experience is required at all. Tandem paragliding means you fly secured in a harness alongside a certified professional pilot who manages every aspect of the flight — from launch to landing. Your only role is to relax, enjoy the views, and take it all in.

faqs.question: Is tandem paragliding safe?
faqs.answer: Tandem paragliding with MauTravel is conducted exclusively with fully certified, experienced professional pilots using regularly inspected and approved safety equipment. All flights are weather-dependent and will only proceed when conditions are assessed as safe by your pilot. Your safety is the absolute priority at every step.

faqs.question: What should I wear and bring?
faqs.answer: Wear comfortable, close-fitting clothing appropriate for the weather. Sturdy closed-toe shoes — trainers or walking shoes — are strongly recommended. Avoid scarves, loose layers, or flowing garments. Sunglasses with a secure strap and sunscreen are advisable. Your pilot will provide any additional pre-flight guidance.

faqs.question: Can children participate?
faqs.answer: Children may participate subject to minimum age, weight, and health requirements. We recommend contacting MauTravel directly via WhatsApp with your child's age and weight before booking so we can confirm eligibility and advise accordingly.

faqs.question: How long is the total paragliding experience?
faqs.answer: The complete experience — including the ascent to the take-off site, equipment fitting, safety briefing, and the flight itself — typically takes between 45 minutes and 2 hours depending on the location chosen. The actual paragliding flight lasts approximately 15–25 minutes.

faqs.question: What happens if the weather is unsuitable on my booking date?
faqs.answer: Your pilot and the MauTravel team monitor wind and weather conditions carefully ahead of every flight. If conditions are not suitable on your scheduled date, we will contact you promptly to reschedule to the next available date at no additional charge.

faqs.question: Can I take my phone or camera during the flight?
faqs.answer: We strongly recommend securing all personal belongings before take-off. Phones and cameras must be attached with a wrist strap or mounted on a secure harness. Your pilot will advise on what is safe to carry. A professional photo and video package may be available on request — please enquire when booking.

hiking-adventures.name: Hiking Adventures
hiking-adventures.pageTitle: Hiking in Mauritius — Guided Mountain & Trail Hikes
hiking-adventures.pageDescription: Explore Mauritius's volcanic peaks and forest trails on expert-guided hikes. Le Morne, Pieter Both, Le Pouce, Lion Mountain and more. Book with MauTravel.
hiking-adventures.heroSubtitle: Conquer volcanic summits, traverse forested ridges, and discover sweeping panoramas of the Mauritian landscape on guided hikes suited to every level — from gentle walks to challenging peak ascents.
about: Mauritius is far more than beaches — its volcanic interior is laced with dramatic mountain trails, dense forests, and viewpoints that reward the effort with unforgettable panoramas of turquoise lagoons and rolling sugarcane fields. MauTravel partners with expert local guides who know every trail intimately.

Our hiking programme covers the full range of Mauritius's peaks and trails: the iconic UNESCO-listed Le Morne Brabant, the challenging rock scramble of Pieter Both, the accessible ridgeline of Le Pouce above Port Louis, and lesser-known gems like Piton Savanne, Tourelle du Tamarin and Montagne Cocotte. Each hike is tailored to your group's fitness level and interests.

All hikes are led by certified, experienced guides who provide full equipment guidance, safety briefings, and fascinating insights into the island's geology, flora and fauna. Whether you're a first-time hiker or a seasoned trail runner, we have a route that will challenge and inspire you.
notIncluded: Hiking boots (strongly recommended — rental available on request)
National park entry fees where applicable

pricing.name: Half Day Hike
pricing.description: A 3–4 hour guided hike on one of our shorter routes such as Le Pouce or Corps de Garde.

pricing.name: Full Day Hike
pricing.description: A 6–8 hour guided ascent of a major peak — Le Morne, Pieter Both or Piton de la Petite Rivière Noire.

pricing.name: Private Group Package
pricing.description: Exclusive guided hiking for your group — choose your peak and we build a custom day around your abilities.

faqs.question: Do I need prior hiking experience?
faqs.answer: Not at all. We offer routes graded from beginner-friendly (Le Pouce, Signal Mountain) to challenging technical ascents (Pieter Both, Piton de la Petite Rivière Noire). Tell us your fitness level when booking and we'll match you to the perfect trail.

faqs.question: What should I wear and bring?
faqs.answer: We recommend lightweight, breathable clothing, sturdy closed-toe shoes or hiking boots, a hat, sunscreen, and a small daypack. We provide water but suggest bringing extra snacks. A full kit list is sent upon booking confirmation.

faqs.question: Is Le Morne suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: The lower section of Le Morne Brabant is accessible to reasonably fit beginners. The upper section involves some scrambling and is recommended for those comfortable with heights and uneven terrain. Your guide will advise on the day based on conditions and your group's ability.

faqs.question: What is the best time of year for hiking in Mauritius?
faqs.answer: The cooler, drier months of May to November are ideal for hiking. Trails can be slippery during the wet season (December to April) and some routes may be temporarily closed after heavy rain. We monitor conditions daily and will advise if a route needs to be adjusted.

faqs.question: How fit do I need to be for the full-day hikes?
faqs.answer: Full-day hikes to major peaks such as Pieter Both or Le Morne Brabant require a good level of fitness and comfortable walking for 5–7 hours. If you are unsure, start with a half-day hike to assess your stamina, or contact us to discuss your fitness level before booking.

waterfalls-river-treks.name: Waterfalls & River Treks
waterfalls-river-treks.pageDescription: Discover Mauritius's hidden waterfalls and jungle river treks — Tamarind Falls, Rochester Falls, 500ft Waterfall and more. Guided adventures with MauTravel.
waterfalls-river-treks.heroSubtitle: Follow wild rivers through tropical gorges, swim beneath thundering cascades, and discover the hidden natural wonders of Mauritius's lush interior — experiences that no beach excursion can match.
about: Mauritius hides some of the Indian Ocean's most spectacular waterfalls and river gorges deep within its volcanic interior. MauTravel's waterfall and river trek experiences take you off the tourist trail and into landscapes of extraordinary natural beauty — thick jungle canopy, volcanic rock formations, and crystal-clear freshwater pools.

The undisputed highlight of any waterfall itinerary is the Tamarind Falls — also known as the 7 Cascades — a series of seven magnificent waterfalls cascading through a steep, forested gorge in the Tamarin area. Other unmissable destinations include the dramatically flat ledge of Rochester Falls, the powerful 500ft Waterfall, the tranquil Alexandra Falls, and the serene Eau Bleue and Léon waterfalls tucked away in the island's southern highlands.

Every trek is led by experienced local guides who know the safest river crossings, the best swimming pools, and the hidden viewpoints that make each journey unique. These are genuine wilderness experiences — not tourist paths — so you can expect mud, water, and memories that last a lifetime.
notIncluded: Water shoes or trekking sandals (essential — rental available)
Change of clothing for after swimming

pricing.name: Single Waterfall Trek
pricing.description: A half-day guided trek to one major waterfall with swimming — perfect for families or those short on time.

pricing.name: Tamarind 7 Cascades
pricing.description: The signature waterfall experience — a full traverse of all seven cascades in the Tamarin gorge.

pricing.name: Multi-Waterfall Day
pricing.description: Visit two or three different waterfall sites in one day for the ultimate Mauritius waterfall experience.

faqs.question: How difficult are the river treks?
faqs.answer: Most waterfall treks are rated moderate — they involve walking on uneven terrain, crossing streams, and scrambling over rocks. Participants should be reasonably fit and comfortable on rough ground. We do not recommend these treks for guests with serious mobility issues.

faqs.question: What footwear should I wear?
faqs.answer: Water shoes or sturdy trekking sandals with grip are essential. Regular trainers are not suitable as they will get wet and can become slippery. If you don't have suitable footwear, please let us know and we can advise on rental options.

faqs.question: Is it safe to swim in the waterfalls?
faqs.answer: Yes — we only swim at locations that our guides have assessed as safe. We avoid swimming during or immediately after heavy rainfall when currents can be stronger. Your guide will assess conditions on the day and make the final decision on swimming.

faqs.question: Can children participate?
faqs.answer: Children aged 8 and above can join most waterfall treks with a parent or guardian. Some more challenging routes are adult-only. Please advise us of children's ages when booking so we can recommend the most suitable experience.

faqs.question: What is the best waterfall to visit in Mauritius?
faqs.answer: Tamarind Falls (7 Cascades) is widely considered the most spectacular and is our most popular trek. Rochester Falls is the easiest and most accessible, making it great for families. The 500ft Waterfall offers the most dramatic single cascade. We can recommend the best option for your group.

7-caves-exploration.name: 7 Caves Exploration
7-caves-exploration.pageTitle: 7 Caves Exploration Mauritius | Volcanic Lava Tube Adventure | MauTravel
7-caves-exploration.pageDescription: Discover the hidden volcanic lava tubes of Mauritius on a guided 7 Caves Exploration. Journey through ancient underground chambers, spectacular rock formations and geological wonders. Book with MauTravel.
7-caves-exploration.heroSubtitle: Journey beneath the surface and discover the hidden volcanic world of Mauritius — ancient lava tubes, dramatic underground chambers, and geological wonders that most visitors never see.
about: Beneath the lush surface of Mauritius lies a geological underworld of extraordinary beauty. Formed millions of years ago during periods of intense volcanic activity, the island's lava tubes are among its most remarkable and least-known natural treasures. The 7 Caves Exploration takes you deep into this hidden world — a series of interconnected volcanic tunnels and chambers that wind through ancient rock formations shaped by rivers of molten lava long before human eyes ever saw them.

Walking through these underground passages is a genuinely immersive experience. The cave walls reveal layer upon layer of volcanic history — smooth lava flows, dramatic stalactite formations, and rock textures in striking shades of black, red and ochre. Your expert local guide brings the geology to life, explaining how each chamber was formed and what it tells us about the volcanic origins of the island. It is a rare opportunity to understand Mauritius not just as a tropical paradise, but as a place of extraordinary geological significance.

The 7 Caves Exploration is designed to be accessible to a wide range of guests — no previous caving or climbing experience is required. The pace is relaxed and the route is carefully chosen to balance discovery with safety. Whether you are a curious family, a couple seeking something beyond the beach, or a dedicated nature lover, this underground adventure will be one of the most memorable and unexpected highlights of your time in Mauritius.
included: Expert local guide with geological knowledge

pricing.name: Guided Cave Exploration
pricing.description: A fully guided 3–4 hour exploration of all 7 volcanic caves with expert geological commentary.

pricing.name: Private Group Tour
pricing.description: An exclusive private exploration for your group — ideal for families, couples and small parties.

faqs.question: Is the cave exploration safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 7 Caves tour is fully guided by an experienced local expert and is suitable for beginners. A comprehensive safety briefing is given before entry, and helmets and head torches are provided. The route has been carefully selected to offer a genuine underground experience while maintaining the highest safety standards throughout.

faqs.question: Can children join the exploration?
faqs.answer: Yes, children aged 8 and above can participate with a parent or guardian. The route is accessible for reasonably active children and the pace is always set to suit the group. Please advise us of children's ages when booking so we can prepare accordingly and confirm the most suitable route.

faqs.question: Do I need previous caving experience?
faqs.answer: No previous experience is required at all. The 7 Caves Exploration is designed for first-time visitors to underground environments. Your guide will walk you through every step and the pace is entirely relaxed — there is no rushing, no climbing, and no tight passages that require special skills.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Comfortable, fitted clothing that you don't mind getting dusty is ideal. Closed-toe shoes with a good grip are essential — sandals, open shoes and flip-flops are not permitted for safety reasons. The temperature inside the caves is slightly cooler than outside, so a light layer is a good idea. Helmets are provided.

faqs.question: Is photography allowed inside the caves?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — photography is warmly encouraged. Smartphones and compact cameras work well inside the caves. Your guide will point out the best formations and lighting angles for memorable shots. Please take care not to touch or lean on geological formations when positioning for photographs.

faqs.question: What is the best time of day to visit?
faqs.answer: The caves can be explored in the morning or afternoon, and conditions inside remain consistent throughout the day regardless of external weather. Morning departures are popular for guests who wish to combine the cave exploration with another activity in the afternoon. We will confirm the ideal departure time when you book.

wild-south-experience.name: The Wild South Experience
wild-south-experience.pageTitle: Wild South Mauritius — Gris Gris, Natural Pools & Hidden Beaches
wild-south-experience.pageDescription: Explore the dramatic and untouched southern coast of Mauritius — Gris Gris cliffs, natural rock pools, hidden beaches and scenic viewpoints. Book with MauTravel.
wild-south-experience.heroSubtitle: Discover the wild, untouched southern coastline of Mauritius — volcanic cliffs, crashing ocean waves, secret rock pools, and hidden beaches that the resort crowds never find.
about: The south coast of Mauritius is a world apart from the calm lagoons and resort hotels that most visitors experience. Here, the Indian Ocean meets the island with full force — dramatic volcanic cliffs, powerful surf, and rugged coastal scenery that feels genuinely wild and untouched. The Wild South Experience is our signature full-day exploration of this extraordinary coastline.

The centrepiece is Gris Gris, arguably the most dramatic viewpoint on the entire island — a clifftop promontory where waves crash spectacularly against black volcanic rock while the ocean stretches uninterrupted to Antarctica. From here, the journey continues along the southern coast, discovering natural rock pools carved by centuries of wave action, secret beaches accessible only by foot, and sweeping panoramic viewpoints over the ocean and the highlands.

Unlike a standard island tour, the Wild South Experience is designed for guests who want to move beyond the postcard scenes and encounter Mauritius in its most raw, authentic form. Your guide brings deep local knowledge of every hidden path, viewpoint and pool along the route — places that simply aren't in any guidebook.

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.value: Gris Gris, natural pools, hidden beaches

included: Packed lunch or lunch stop at local restaurant
notIncluded: Swimming costume and towel (for natural pools)

pricing.name: Wild South Day

pricing.name: Photography Special
pricing.description: A photographer-focused version of the Wild South tour, timed for golden-hour light at Gris Gris and the coastal cliffs.

faqs.question: Is the Wild South suitable for families with young children?
faqs.answer: The Wild South Experience is best suited to adults and older children (10+) due to the uneven cliff-top terrain near Gris Gris and some of the natural pool locations. The vehicle-based sections are suitable for all ages. Please contact us to discuss your group composition.

faqs.question: Can we swim at the natural pools?
faqs.answer: Yes — the natural rock pools along the southern coast are sheltered enough for safe swimming on most days. However, the open coastline at Gris Gris is not suitable for swimming due to strong currents and waves. Your guide will always assess conditions before any water entry.

faqs.question: What is the road access like on the south coast?
faqs.answer: Most of the southern coastal route is accessed via good tar roads. Some hidden locations involve short walks on rough coastal tracks. Our vehicles are well-maintained and suitable for the terrain. We recommend wearing comfortable shoes for the walking sections.

faqs.question: Is this different from a standard South Tour?
faqs.answer: Yes, significantly. A standard South Tour typically focuses on popular stops like Chamarel Coloured Earths, Le Morne and rum distilleries. The Wild South Experience focuses exclusively on the raw coastal scenery, hidden natural spots and less-visited locations that most tour operators don't include.

faqs.question: What time does the tour start and finish?
faqs.answer: The tour typically departs between 7:30–8:30am from your hotel and returns in the late afternoon (around 4:00–5:00pm). Departure times can be adjusted for photographers wishing to catch early morning light. Exact times are confirmed upon booking.

mangrove-kayaking.name: Mangrove Kayaking
mangrove-kayaking.pageTitle: Mangrove Kayaking Mauritius — Guided Coastal Kayak Tours
mangrove-kayaking.pageDescription: Paddle through Mauritius's ancient mangrove forests and sheltered coastal channels on a guided kayak tour. A peaceful, immersive nature experience for all abilities. Book with MauTravel.
mangrove-kayaking.heroSubtitle: Glide silently through ancient mangrove forests and tranquil coastal channels, discovering Mauritius's extraordinary wetland ecosystems and the hidden wildlife that calls them home.
about: Mauritius's mangrove forests are among the island's most extraordinary and least-visited natural treasures. These protected coastal wetlands — where the sea meets the land in a tangle of roots, shallow channels and wildlife-rich water — offer a completely different side of the island from the resort beaches most visitors experience.

MauTravel's guided mangrove kayaking experience takes you through sheltered channels on a sit-on-top kayak, accompanied by a knowledgeable local guide who will point out the birds, fish and marine life that inhabit these fragile ecosystems. The pace is entirely gentle — this is not an adrenaline sport but a peaceful, immersive encounter with nature.

No prior kayaking experience is needed. The routes are calm and sheltered, suitable for families, couples and solo travellers of all fitness levels. A short paddling lesson is given before you set off, and the guide accompanies the group throughout to ensure everyone is comfortable and enjoying the experience at their own pace.

pricing.name: Guided Kayak Tour
pricing.description: A 2–3 hour guided paddle through Mauritius's mangrove channels with a certified local guide.

pricing.name: Private Group Tour
pricing.description: An exclusive private kayaking experience for your group — ideal for families and couples.

faqs.question: Do I need kayaking experience?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Our mangrove routes follow calm, sheltered channels that are ideal for first-time paddlers. Your guide will give a short technique lesson before you set off and will paddle alongside you throughout the experience.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Yes — mangrove kayaking is one of our most family-friendly experiences. Children aged 6 and above can paddle in tandem kayaks with a parent. Life jackets are provided in all sizes. Please let us know children's ages when booking so we can prepare the right equipment.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Wear light, comfortable clothing that you don't mind getting slightly wet. A hat, sunglasses, and reef-safe sunscreen are strongly recommended. Secure footwear (water shoes or trainers) is preferred over sandals or flip-flops.

faqs.question: What wildlife might we see?
faqs.answer: Mauritius's mangrove channels are home to a variety of bird species including herons, kingfishers and egrets, as well as small fish, crabs and other marine life visible in the shallow clear water. Sightings vary by season and time of day — early morning paddles tend to be particularly rewarding for wildlife.

faqs.question: What time of day is best for kayaking?
faqs.answer: Early morning is ideal — the water is calmest, the light is beautiful, and wildlife activity is at its peak. Afternoon tours are also available and offer a different, equally enjoyable experience. We will confirm the best departure time for your group when booking.

dolphin-encounter.name: Dolphin Encounter
dolphin-encounter.pageTitle: Dolphin Encounter Mauritius — Swim with Wild Dolphins
dolphin-encounter.pageDescription: Swim with wild dolphins in Tamarin Bay, Mauritius. An unforgettable ethical wildlife encounter in the warm Indian Ocean. Book with MauTravel.
dolphin-encounter.heroSubtitle: Experience one of the most magical wildlife encounters in the Indian Ocean — swimming alongside pods of wild spinner dolphins in the warm, crystal-clear waters of Tamarin Bay.
about: Mauritius is one of very few places in the world where you can swim with wild dolphins in their natural habitat. Tamarin Bay on the west coast is home to resident pods of spinner dolphins, who gather in the bay during the early morning hours before heading out to sea.

MauTravel's dolphin encounter is an ethical, respectful wildlife experience. We work exclusively with operators who follow strict guidelines to ensure minimal disturbance to the dolphins. Guests enter the water quietly and allow the dolphins to approach naturally — there is no chasing, no touching, and no captivity.

The experience typically begins at dawn, when the dolphins are most active near shore. You'll travel by boat to find the pod, then gently slip into the water to observe and swim alongside them. It's a moment of pure magic that travellers describe as a life highlight.

pricing.name: Standard
pricing.description: Join a small shared boat for the dolphin encounter experience.

pricing.name: Family Pack
pricing.description: A dedicated family boat for a more intimate experience.

pricing.name: Private Charter
pricing.description: An exclusive private boat for your group — the ultimate dolphin experience.

faqs.question: Is it guaranteed we'll see dolphins?
faqs.answer: While dolphins are resident in Tamarin Bay and sightings are very frequent, we cannot guarantee encounters as these are wild animals. In the rare event of no dolphin sighting, we'll discuss options including a partial refund or alternative activity.

faqs.question: Can non-swimmers participate?
faqs.answer: Non-swimmers can join the boat trip and observe from above the water, but will not be able to swim with the dolphins. Life jackets are provided for all guests on board.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Yes, children aged 5 and above can participate. The experience is gentle and suitable for families. Children must be accompanied by an adult in the water.

faqs.question: What time does the tour depart?
faqs.answer: The tour typically departs at sunrise (around 6:00–7:00am) when dolphins are most active near shore. Exact departure times will be confirmed when you book.

faqs.question: Are the dolphins wild or captive?
faqs.answer: The dolphins are completely wild and free. We work only with ethical operators who respect the dolphins' natural behaviour. There is no feeding, no touching, and no captivity involved.

parasailing.name: Parasailing
parasailing.pageTitle: Parasailing Mauritius — Fly Above the Indian Ocean
parasailing.pageDescription: Soar high above Mauritius's stunning lagoon on a parasailing adventure. Solo, tandem or triple options available. Book with MauTravel.
parasailing.heroSubtitle: Experience the thrill of flying high above the Indian Ocean, with breathtaking panoramic views of Mauritius's turquoise lagoon, white beaches and dramatic coastline stretching below you.
about: Parasailing in Mauritius is an exhilarating experience that combines the thrill of flying with some of the most beautiful scenery in the Indian Ocean. Tethered safely to a modern parachute and towed by a professional motorboat, you'll lift gently off the water and ascend to heights of up to 150 metres.

From your vantage point in the sky, the views are nothing short of spectacular — the varied blues and greens of the lagoon, the white ribbon of beach stretching in both directions, and the volcanic peaks of the island's interior rising behind you. It's a perspective of Mauritius that you'll never forget.

Parasailing is available in solo, tandem (two people), and triple (three people) configurations, making it ideal for couples, families, and friends. The take-off and landing both happen from the boat, so you don't even need to get wet — a great option for non-swimmers.

pricing.name: Solo
pricing.description: Take to the skies alone — full 15-minute solo flight.

pricing.name: Tandem
pricing.description: Fly together — perfect for couples and best friends.

pricing.name: Triple
pricing.description: Three up in the air at once — the most fun you'll have on holiday.

faqs.question: Do I need to be able to swim?
faqs.answer: No swimming ability is required. Take-off and landing both take place from the boat — you don't need to enter the water. Life jackets are provided for all passengers.

faqs.question: Is there a weight limit?
faqs.answer: Yes, weight and age restrictions apply for safety reasons. Please contact us with your details and we'll confirm suitability before booking.

faqs.question: Is it scary?
faqs.answer: Most guests are surprised by how smooth and peaceful parasailing is. The ascent is gradual and the flight itself is quiet and serene. Many people say it's far less frightening than they expected!

faqs.question: Can I parasail if I'm pregnant?
faqs.answer: Parasailing is not recommended for pregnant guests. Please contact us to discuss alternative activities.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Wear comfortable clothing and secure any loose items. Avoid flip-flops for safety reasons — closed shoes or bare feet are better. A change of clothes is useful as you may get splashed on the boat.

underwater-walk.name: Underwater Walk
underwater-walk.pageTitle: Underwater Walk Mauritius — Sea Walk Experience
underwater-walk.pageDescription: Walk on the seabed in Mauritius with a pressurised helmet — discover vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish. No swimming experience needed. Book with MauTravel.
underwater-walk.heroSubtitle: Walk on the ocean floor and discover Mauritius's extraordinary underwater world — no diving experience needed. Simply descend in a pressurised helmet and meet the tropical fish face-to-face.
about: The Underwater Walk — also known as a Sea Walk — is one of Mauritius's most unique and accessible water experiences. Unlike scuba diving, there's no training or swimming ability required. Guests of all ages and swimming abilities can participate.

Wearing a specially designed pressurised helmet that maintains air at a comfortable level, you descend a short ladder into the warm, clear waters and walk gently on the sandy seabed. The world around you transforms — tropical fish, sea urchins, and vibrant coral formations surround you in a living aquarium.

The descent is gradual and completely safe, accompanied by a professional underwater guide at all times. Most guests are amazed by how natural and comfortable the experience feels — many describe it as one of the highlights of their entire Mauritius holiday.
notIncluded: Professional underwater photography package (available on request)

pricing.name: Standard
pricing.description: Individual sea walk with certified guide.

pricing.name: With Photos
pricing.description: The same experience plus a professional underwater photo package.

pricing.name: Family Pack
pricing.description: A dedicated group descent for families — memorable for all ages.

faqs.question: Do I need to know how to swim?
faqs.answer: No swimming ability is required. The underwater walk uses a pressurised helmet that keeps your head completely dry throughout the descent. You walk on the seabed rather than swimming.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for people with claustrophobia?
faqs.answer: The helmet is open at the bottom and you are always in a well-lit, open environment. However, if you have significant claustrophobia, we recommend discussing this with us before booking.

faqs.question: Is it safe for older participants?
faqs.answer: The sea walk is suitable for adults up to approximately 60 years. Guests with heart conditions, ear problems, or respiratory issues should consult their doctor before participating.

faqs.question: How deep do we go underwater?
faqs.answer: The descent is approximately 3–4 metres below the surface — deep enough to fully immerse you in the reef ecosystem while remaining safe and comfortable.

faqs.question: Will we see tropical fish?
faqs.answer: Yes — the sea walk site is located above a vibrant coral reef teeming with tropical fish, sea urchins, starfish and other marine life. Fish feeding is included to attract fish close to you.

hero.description: 해안에서 해안까지, 모리셔스를 만나보세요. 상징적인 명소부터 숨겨진 절경, 야생동물, 청록빛 석호, 그리고 잊지 못할 모험까지—당신의 일정에 맞춰 설계된 하나의 여행으로 완성됩니다.

experience.title: 모리셔스 체험
experience.description: 이 패키지는 활기 넘치는 도시와 문화 명소부터 자연, 야생동물, 해변, 모험까지 진짜 모리셔스를 보여드리기 위해 설계되었습니다. 번거로운 준비는 저희가 맡을 테니, 편안하게 매 순간을 즐기세요.

airportTransfer.title: 공항 픽업 및 샌딩 서비스
airportTransfer.description: 여행의 시작과 끝을 편안하게. SSR 국제공항에서 숙소까지 전용 차량으로 모셔다드리고, 출국 시 복귀 이동편도 준비해 드립니다.

pamplemousses.name: 팜플레무스 식물원
pamplemousses.description: 거대한 수련, 이국적인 식물, 향신료, 그리고 수백 년 된 고목들이 가득한 곳입니다.

portLouis.name: 포트루이스 & 코당 워터프론트
portLouis.description: 수도 포트루이스를 둘러보며 다채로운 시장, 현지 문화, 활기찬 해안가 분위기를 만나보세요.

grandBaie.name: 그랑베
grandBaie.description: 아름다운 해변과 상점, 레스토랑이 늘어선 활기찬 해안 마을로, 청록빛 석호 전망이 일품입니다.

capMalheureux.name: 카프 말러
capMalheureux.description: 상징적인 붉은 지붕 교회와 아름다운 해안 풍경, 그리고 숨 막히는 북부의 전망을 자랑합니다.

blackRiverGorges.name: 블랙 리버 고지스
blackRiverGorges.description: 파노라마 전망대, 울창한 숲, 그리고 모리셔스에서 가장 장엄한 풍경 중 하나를 만나보세요.

alexandraFalls.name: 알렉산드라 폭포
alexandraFalls.description: 푸르른 계곡과 쏟아지는 폭포를 한눈에 담을 수 있는 아름다운 전망대입니다.

valleeDesCouleurs.name: 라 발레 데 쿨뢰르 자연공원
valleeDesCouleurs.description: 형형색색의 대지, 폭포, 전망대와 모험 체험이 어우러진 곳입니다.

laVanille.name: 라 바니유 자연공원 (크로커다일 파크)
laVanille.description: 열대의 자연 속에서 거대 육지거북, 악어 등 매혹적인 야생동물을 만나보세요.

casela.title: 카셀라 네이처 파크 체험
casela.description: 야생동물과의 만남부터 짜릿한 스릴 넘치는 체험까지, 카셀라는 모리셔스 여행의 하이라이트 중 하나입니다.
casela.note: 선택된 일부 체험은 선택 사항이거나 추가 요금이 발생할 수 있습니다.

sunset.title: 플릭 앙 플락의 노을
sunset.description: 바닷가에서 여유를 즐기며 황금빛으로 물드는 모리셔스의 하늘을 감상하세요. 잊지 못할 하루를 마무리하는 완벽한 방법입니다.

ileAuxCerfs.name: 일 오 세르프 섬
ileAuxCerfs.description: 수정처럼 맑은 석호와 새하얀 백사장이 펼쳐진, 여유로운 섬 휴양지입니다.

grseWaterfall.name: GRSE 폭포
grseWaterfall.description: 강을 따라 아름다운 경치를 즐기며 그랑 리비에르 수드 에스트 폭포까지 보트로 이동합니다.

snorkelling.name: 스노클링
snorkelling.description: 모리셔스의 다채로운 해양 생물과 신비로운 수중 세계를 탐험해 보세요.

catamaran.name: 카타마란 크루즈
catamaran.description: 바닷바람을 만끽하며 눈부신 해안 풍경 속에서 특별한 하루를 보내세요.

dolphinWatching.description: 이른 아침 보트 투어를 통해 자연 속에서 뛰노는 돌고래들을 관찰해 보세요.

underseaWalk.name: 해저 산책
underseaWalk.headline: 바다 밑을 걷다
underseaWalk.description: 가이드와 함께 수면 아래 산호초를 가까이서 탐험하세요—다이빙 경험이 전혀 필요 없습니다.

quadBiking.name: 쿼드바이크

quadBiking.description: 짜릿한 쿼드바이크를 타고 험준한 지형과 경치 좋은 오솔길을 탐험하세요.

faq.title: 자주 묻는 질문
faq.subtitle: MauTravel과 함께하는 모리셔스 여행 계획에 대해 알아야 할 모든 것.

items.question: 모리셔스 홀리데이 패키지는 맞춤 설정이 가능한가요?
items.answer: 네, 가능합니다. 체류 기간, 인원 수, 포함하고 싶은 체험에 맞춰 패키지를 조정할 수 있습니다. 관광, 자연, 모험, 그리고 휴식 사이의 이상적인 균형을 찾아드리겠습니다.

items.question: 홀리데이 패키지의 일수는 어떻게 되나요?
items.answer: 정해진 기간은 없습니다. 5일, 7일, 10일, 2주 또는 그 외 어떤 기간이든 여행 일정에 맞춰 체험 내용을 조정해 드립니다.

items.question: 커플, 가족 또는 그룹을 위한 패키지 구성도 가능한가요?
items.answer: 네, 가능합니다. 혼자 여행하시는 분, 커플, 가족, 그룹 모두를 위한 여행을 구성할 수 있으며, 교통편 등 세부 사항은 인원 수에 맞춰 조정됩니다.

items.question: 일부 액티비티나 관광지를 변경할 수 있나요?
items.answer: 네, 가능합니다. 이 페이지에 소개된 체험들은 모리셔스 여행에 포함될 수 있는 예시입니다. 관광지나 액티비티를 추가, 삭제 또는 변경하고 싶으시면 MauTravel이 고객님의 관심사와 가능한 시간에 맞춰 패키지를 조정해 드립니다.

items.question: 모리셔스 홀리데이 패키지의 비용은 얼마인가요?
items.answer: 요금은 체류 기간, 인원 수, 선택하신 체험, 최종 패키지 구성에 따라 달라집니다. 여행 날짜와 인원 수를 MauTravel에 알려주시면 맞춤 견적을 준비해 드리겠습니다.

items.question: 숙박과 식사가 포함되나요?
items.answer: 숙박과 식사 구성은 여행을 위해 만들어진 패키지에 따라 달라집니다. 맞춤 견적서에 포함 사항과 선택 가능한 추가 사항이 명확하게 안내됩니다.

items.question: 관광지 입장료가 포함되나요?
items.answer: 입장료는 여행을 위해 최종 선택된 관광지와 액티비티에 따라 달라집니다. 포함된 입장료와 추가 요금은 확정 전 견적서에 명확하게 안내됩니다.

items.question: 교통편이 포함되나요?
items.answer: 여행에 포함된 체험을 위한 전용 교통편은 물론, 공항 픽업 및 샌딩 서비스도 준비해 드립니다. 적합한 차량은 그룹 인원 수에 따라 달라집니다.

items.question: 패러글라이딩과 같은 액티비티도 포함되나요?
items.answer: 여행을 구성할 때 특정 액티비티를 포함할 수 있습니다. 패러글라이딩, 패러세일링, 돌고래 체험, 해저 산책, 쿼드바이크, 폭포 트레킹 등도 취향과 예약 가능 여부, 현장 상황에 따라 추가하실 수 있습니다.

items.question: 날씨로 인해 액티비티가 영향을 받으면 어떻게 되나요?
items.answer: 일부 야외 및 해양 액티비티는 날씨에 영향을 받습니다. 안전하게 진행할 수 없는 경우, MauTravel이 예약 가능 여부와 액티비티 제공업체의 조건에 따라 적절한 대안이나 일정 변경을 도와드립니다.

items.question: 모리셔스 여행은 어떻게 예약하나요?
items.answer: 여행 날짜, 인원 수, 관심 있는 체험을 MauTravel에 알려주세요. 고객님의 일정에 맞춰 여행을 조정해 드리고, 확정하시기 전에 상세 정보와 맞춤 견적을 안내해 드리겠습니다.
